stem: Which statement correctly describes how a landform is formed?

options.label: F
options.text: A lake is formed when flowing water carves out the sides of a canyon.

options.label: G
options.text: A mountain range is formed when glaciers slowly move across the landscape.

options.label: H
options.text: A delta is formed at the mouth of a river when flowing water slows and deposits sediment.

options.label: J
options.text: A U-shaped valley is formed when winds pick up and move sediment away from the landscape.
